name: Hotel Las Islas Baru
positioning: Seafront bungalow resort on Barú, within the Rosario Islands National Park, reached by boat from Cartagena
best_for: Couples wanting a treetop or private-pool bungalow by the sea
Families wanting a two-bedroom bungalow with its own pool
Travelers who want snorkeling, night plankton tours and spa time in one stay

facts.text: Hotel Las Islas is on the seafront within the Rosario Islands National Park.
The boat ride from the La Bodeguita dock in Cartagena to the hotel takes approximately 45 minutes.
The hotel has a heliport and offers helicopter service to and from Cartagena, with an approximate flight time of 18 minutes.
The sea level bungalows have a private pool and a furnished deck with a hammock, sun loungers and a dining area.
The Grand Family Bungalow is a two-bedroom bungalow at sea level with a private pool.
Spa Niña Daniela is the hotel's beachfront spa and wellness center, designed by a local architect.
The spa's wellness center has a thalassotherapy pool, a jacuzzi, a sauna and a Turkish bath.
Las Guacas restaurant serves dinner surrounded by vegetation and orchids, with Colombian and international specialties.
Choco Bar & Restaurant is the beach restaurant and bar, with oven pizzas, sandwiches, skewers and grilled seafood.
A local Barú cook teaches cooking classes in traditional regional dishes such as ceviche.
The snorkeling tour departs from the hotel's reception dock to a point in the Corales del Rosario National Natural Park.
The hotel has planted mangroves to help regenerate the surrounding ecosystem.

highlights.text: The treetop bungalows sit either eight or 12 meters above the ground, each with a furnished deck, a hammock and a hydromassage Jacuzzi tub.
Isleta is a private island that is part of the hotel, with a white sand beach; the transfer is free for guests, subject to availability.
The hotel has a stargazing deck with a Celestron CGX-L telescope, and the astrotour is a courtesy for guests.
The Sunset in Casa Navegante is a two-hour boat tour that departs every evening toward Ciénaga de Cholón.
Las Islas Bar is on the third floor of the Club House, with a 360-degree view over the hotel complex.

considerations.text: Getting there takes some planning: about 45 minutes by boat from Cartagena, or about 90 minutes by road from Rafael Núñez International Airport.
Transfers to Isleta are subject to availability and must be coordinated with the hotel and Isleta reception staff.
The spa's wet areas and meditation room are used by reservation.
